description: This file defines FastAPI routes for managing and retrieving match data, event data, and related entities in a sports live stream platform. It includes endpoints for listing matches, getting match details, live matches, highlights, upcoming matches, as well as event-related data, integrating with database services and model conversions.

methods.description: Converts a database match model to a corresponding Pydantic model, fetching team info and match events as needed.
